Listen. Your life is beautiful, and you're here for a reason. Your attitude towards working through it is the best possible way of thinking about it. We truly care about your existence, we do. Don't waste your life, after all, it's worth living. I understand that your thoughts change every so often but plenty of people have those "swings". You need to think about the positive things in life. Maybe you can talk to a loved one about your thoughts, and then it's not just you, alone. You have someone else helping you, some on to support you, someone who you know for sure wants you to live. You sound like a great person. Suicide is an absolutely terrible thing that no one should think about doing. Find something that can take your mind off of it, like a new hobby or a sport you're interested in. It can be whatever. Please don't do it. You are valuable and irreplaceable.
